# Business Internet Quotes

> Business Internet Quotes (businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com) is a free service that finds business-grade internet service providers available at a specific commercial address. A business submits its legal name, service address, and contact details once; we check the business-grade ISPs serviceable at that exact address and return quotes — including monthly cost, install timeline, hardware fees, and contract length. The service is free to the business; carriers pay a referral commission when a business signs service. We are not a carrier or reseller and do not sell submitted information.

## Pages

- [Home](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/): how it works and the quote request form.
- [FAQ](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/faq): common questions about business internet, coverage lookups, install timelines, and the quote process.
- [Privacy](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/privacy): what is collected and how it is used.
- [Do Not Sell or Share](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/do-not-sell): CCPA/CPRA stance.
- [Terms](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/terms): terms and conditions.
- [Accessibility](https://businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com/accessibility): accessibility statement.

## Facts

- Service area: United States (quotes are address-specific to a commercial location).
- Cost to the business: free, no obligation.
- Business-grade focus: symmetrical speeds, SLAs, static IPs, dedicated lines — not residential service.
- Contact: quotes@businessinternetsearch.sdfkjh.com
